data.name: Cocoa Loco
data.detailed_description:
Cocoa Loco is a cosy café game where you play as Zoey, a waitress working at a very unusual store. There’s no tea or coffee here, only decadent chocolate creations and sugary delights.

Take Orders, Deliver Drinks, Wash Dishes!

Inspired by the restaurant simulation flash games of the early 2000s, Cocoa Loco focuses on the moment to moment decisions of running a busy café. Juggle orders, impatient customers, and the growing chaos as more guests arrive looking for something sweet. Customers seat themselves and wait for their order to be taken. Send their drink to the kitchen, deliver it before their patience runs out, then clear the table and wash the dishes so the next guests can sit down.

Save, upgrade and customise

Buy new furniture to make your café more comfortable and encourage customers to linger. Upgrade sinks and dishwashers to keep up with the mess and invest in faster machines to prepare drinks more efficiently. Unlock stylish wallpapers, new floors, hanging plants, and lighting to match the café aesthetic of your dreams, and add entertainment like jukeboxes, TVs, or radios to keep customers patient while they wait. 

Charm, Chaos and Mystery

Zoey left her hometown years ago and everyone assumed she had gone on to bigger and better things. Now she suddenly appears working at her mother's chocolate café. Nobody knows why she's back. Did she not become successful on her own? Or was there something in her home town that brought her back? 

MORE TO COME!

Cocoa Loco is a independently made game by one game developer. All of the art, programming and design have been undertaken by myself (Hello! it's me also writing the descriptions for Steam as well!) while working and studying full-time. I have loved working on this game and want it to be best experience for players of the cosy genre. Understand it is still currently in development and might take a little longer than expected.

data.short_description: It’s Zoey’s first day working at a cosy café! Wait tables and manage the rush, to earn money for new equipment and redesign the space to your liking. As the days pass, unlock new drinks and uncover the heartfelt story of Zoey’s past, along with the lingering mystery surrounding her mother’s fate.
